title: Don’t Waste Money
body: Bought 2.99 expansion pack and it didn’t work. Unable to play more than the 20 words initially available.

title: Not working
body: I bought one of the expansion packs and I try to toggle it on and it doesn’t work.

title: A big hit
body: Glad to see a phone version my family loves this game- taking it in our travels. First 20 words are free and two players, otherwise have to purchase inexpensive upgrades but worth it for the price. My upgrades (additional words) showed up fine I just closed and reopened the app after purchasing.
